text:
Iris M: FYI HarborBridge (marketplace) requested a SKU-aware reranker to prioritize items with high conversion probability. Must run in their VPC, use customer HSM (Yubico), and redact emails/ssn fragments. They want a pilot in ~5 weeks. Intake: https://redwood.internal/HB-907

ops-bot: Intake HB-907 created assigned to Iris Mtags=[customer-success,eng-ml,security,legal]

Julian K: Quick question  label type? click-through converted pairs or merchant-annotated purchases? affects loss and sampling strategy.

Iris M: Merchant can provide conversion-labeled pairs (~120k) plus clickstream features. Multilang not required. Prefers a 7B or 6.7B variant, latency goal p50 ~55ms, p95 < 140ms.

Tara P: Security: any PCI/PHI expected? HSM vendor details? Also need to confirm they want zero logs leaving VPC.

Iris M: No PHI, some free-text may contain emails or masked cc fragments. HSM vendor is Yubico (customer-managed). They require no raw user text outside VPC; redaction must occur client-side.

Julian K: Can we get a 1k stratified holdout for perf and ranking evals? We'll run NDCG@5 and Recall@10. Also need target QPS for infra sizing.

Iris M: Shared sample and schema: https://redwood.internal/drive/HB-907/samples.tar.gz. Traffic expectation 160 QPS steady, burst 320. NDCG@5 target >=0.44.

OpsLegal: I'll draft a DPA addendum for HSM/key custody and data residency. Need Yubico cert chain and SOC2 attestation from HarborBridge.

Tara P: Infra note  private control plane + HSM wiring will require a maintenance window and cert provisioning. Quantization may affect p95; recommend perf runs on int8 and int4 if feasible.

Julian K: Plan estimate: ingest & validation (4d), finetune (8d), quant+perf (4d), infra+HSM+canary (6d). About 4.5 weeks total if no blockers.

Iris M: Cool. I'll push for signatures on the DPA and ask HarborBridge to drop the holdout by EOD tomorrow. Will schedule kickoff once DPA is signed. :calendar:
